ClockActionAudit.limits: Conditional static register-action model only. Initial reset/default interval and register-switch transients are not bounded physical VCO proof. Pre6 stages472.5/378MHz at27MHz input are below the Linux-inferred500MHz lower bound; local minimum usability and analog lock are unproven. Static upper-bound acceptance does not validate every analog action. Expected read checks are not measurements. RMW preserves undocumented bits by declared contract or supplied unverified pre-read, not hardware proof; a masked match alone cannot excuse a write-data NACK. Standby/bypass is not PLL power-off. No complete720 recipe, RTL, PCLK implementation, measured clock, frame rate, optics or hardware release.
